item.title: Kartik Srinivasan Appointed Editor-in-Chief of Optica Quantum
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Optica Publishing Group is pleased to announce that Kartik Srinivasan has been appointed as the new editor-in-chief of Optica Quantum. Srinivasan is a National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Fellow and Fellow of the NIST/University of Maryland Joint Quantum Institute, where he also serves as Co-Director and as an Adjunct […]
